items.title: Social Media Marketing: Build a Loyal Community
items.excerpt: Social media is where your audience lives. Here is how we plan, create and manage content so your brand stands out instead of just existing.
items.imageAlt: Smartphone home screen with social media app icons
items.bodyHtml:
Why social media is essential

Social media is where your audience lives. Our social media marketing strategies make sure you do not just exist. You stand out.

What we offer

  • Daily post design and scheduling
  • Hashtag strategy and trend usage
  • Story and reel marketing
  • Engagement and comment management
  • Influencer and collaboration marketing

What we do

Content calendars

We plan, design and schedule posts across all major platforms to keep your brand consistent and relevant.

Reels and story marketing

Our creative team produces platform-specific videos (Reels, Shorts and TikToks) that improve discoverability and engagement.

Engagement and community building

Responding to comments, starting conversations and running polls keeps your audience active and loyal.

items.title: From Startup to Standout: The Power of Public Relations
items.excerpt: Paid promotions get you noticed fast, and integrated digital marketing and PR builds the trust that keeps you there.
items.imageAlt: Scrabble tiles spelling AdWords on a wooden surface
items.bodyHtml:
Unlock the power of digital marketing and PR

Paid promotions: get noticed instantly

Paid promotions advertise your content or brand through paid channels such as Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram promotions and influencer collaborations.

Why paid ads matter

  • Immediate visibility and traffic
  • Precisely targeted audience reach
  • Scalable, measurable results

Types of paid promotion we offer

  • Google Ads (Search and Display)
  • Facebook and Instagram sponsored posts
  • YouTube video ads
  • LinkedIn and X (Twitter) ads
  • Influencer paid campaigns

Why settle for less? Experience integrated digital marketing and PR

Your innovative tech solutions deserve a powerful voice. Our digital marketing and PR services are designed to build a strong online presence, foster trust and accelerate lead generation for IT companies, tech startups and software developers.

The force multiplier: digital marketing plus PR for tech

In the competitive tech space, an integrated strategy is key. Our digital marketing and PR services work together so your company gains maximum visibility, earns trust and drives significant business results.

items.title: Content Marketing: Educate, Engage, and Convert
items.excerpt: Content marketing attracts and retains a clearly defined audience with valuable, relevant and consistent content. Here is what works.
items.imageAlt: Hand with a stylus over a glowing tablet
items.bodyHtml:
Driving growth through value

Content marketing is a strategy focused on creating and distributing valuable, relevant and consistent content to attract and retain a clearly defined audience.

Why it works

  • Builds authority in your niche
  • Supports SEO and organic reach
  • Drives engagement and trust

What we deliver

  • Blog articles and SEO content
  • Infographics and visual posts
  • E-books and whitepapers
  • Email newsletters
  • Video scripts and storytelling

Increasing organic reach on social media

Organic reach is the number of people who see your content without paid promotion. Algorithms have made it harder to gain reach without ads, but strategic posting can still deliver strong visibility and engagement.

Content that adds value

We focus on content that educates, entertains or solves a problem, which maximises shares, saves and likes.

Consistent use of reels and short videos

Social algorithms prioritise short-form video. We make sure your reels are timely, trend-aligned and creatively executed.

Hashtag and caption optimisation

We research and rotate niche-relevant hashtags and write captions with clear calls to action that drive interaction.

Strategic tagging and collaborations

Tagging partners, creators or local businesses increases exposure across their follower networks.

Giveaways and contests

Engagement-based contests increase shares, follows and page saves while building buzz.

How content marketing works

Instead of selling directly, content marketing provides useful information, entertainment or solutions through blog posts, videos and social media. This builds trust, establishes your brand as an authority and nurtures relationships, guiding your audience to become loyal customers and driving profitable action.

items.title: Online Reputation Management (ORM)
items.excerpt: Your online reputation is your most valuable digital asset. What ORM is, why it matters and the services we provide.
items.imageAlt: Graphic titled Why ORM Matters: Protect Your Brand
items.bodyHtml:
Why ORM matters

ORM directly shapes how customers perceive your brand, which affects their trust and your bottom line. Your online reputation is your most valuable digital asset. It builds credibility, defends against negativity, boosts visibility and drives growth.

What is ORM?

Online Reputation Management means monitoring and influencing your business's digital reputation across platforms like Google Reviews, JustDial, Facebook and Trustpilot.

  • Defends against negative reviews. Proactive ORM lets you address bad feedback and turn potential crises into chances to show great service.
  • Boosts search results. Strong reviews and positive mentions improve your visibility and ranking, helping more people find you.
  • Enhances credibility. A well-managed reputation signals professionalism and authenticity.
  • Builds customer trust. A positive online presence shows transparency and reliability, making customers more confident in your brand.

Our ORM services

  • Review monitoring and responses
  • Removal or reporting of fake reviews
  • Positive feedback campaigns
  • Press coverage and PR releases
  • Google Business Profile optimisation

Is ORM worth it?

Absolutely. Your online presence is often the first impression people have of your brand, and it influences whether customers, partners and even employees trust you. A strong ORM strategy helps you shape that narrative, build credibility and attract more business by protecting your brand from negative information while amplifying positive experiences.

items.title: Drive Targeted Traffic & Leads
items.bodyHtml:
Case Study 1

Igniting E-commerce Sales with Precision Paid Promotions

The Challenge: A budding D2C fashion brand, “StyleSavvy,” had a fantastic product line but struggled to cut through the noise in a highly competitive online market. Their previous ad campaigns yielded low ROI and inconsistent sales.

Our Solution: CredTech Solutions initiated a comprehensive Paid Promotions (Google & Meta Ads) strategy. We began with in-depth audience research to identify StyleSavvy’s ideal customer segments. We then developed highly targeted ad creatives and compelling copy for both Google Shopping and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads. Our approach included:

  • Granular Audience Segmentation: Targeting users based on demographics, interests, purchase behavior, and lookalike audiences.
  • Dynamic Product Ads: Showcasing specific products to users who had previously shown interest.
  • A/B Testing: Continuously optimizing ad creatives, headlines, and calls-to-action for maximum conversion.
  • Bid Optimization: Leveraging advanced bidding strategies to ensure cost-efficiency and high ROI.

The Results: Within six months, StyleSavvy witnessed an average of 350% Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) . Their online sales increased by 80% , and their customer acquisition cost (CAC) decreased by 40%, proving the power of strategically managed paid campaigns.
